summary: Handles the next JPEG restart marker. Ensures a current marker exists at this+0x178 (reading one via BitstreamTokenReader when it is zero) and compares it against the expected value counter + 208. On a match it reports state 97 through the parameterized dispatcher with the counter value, clears the current marker, and increments the counter modulo 8. On a mismatch it delegates to an alternative handler reached through a vfunc on the stream object, and increments the counter when that handler accepts the marker. Returns 0 when no marker can be read and no handler accepts it.

local_names.a1[94]: current marker byte at this+0x178 (0 when no marker is pending)
local_names.a1[100]: sub-object pointer at this+0x190 holding the restart counter at its +84 offset
local_names.counter: restart interval counter (0-7); expected marker equals counter + 208

operations.description: If the current marker at this+0x178 is zero, load the next marker by calling BitstreamTokenReader; the function returns 0 when no marker can be produced
Expected-marker match: compare the current marker at this+0x178 against the restart counter stored at (this+0x190 value)+84 plus 208 (0xD0)
On a match write state 97 to obj+0x14 and the current counter value to obj+0x18
Parameterized dispatch of the matched restart marker through the second vtable entry (obj+0x4) with argument 3
Clear the current marker at this+0x178 back to 0 after the match is dispatched

On a mismatch, delegate to the alternative marker handler reached through vfunc at (this+0x14 stream object)+0x14, passing the current counter value; a true return accepts the marker and falls through to the counter increment
Increment the restart counter at (this+0x190 value)+84 modulo 8: ((counter as byte) + 1) & 7
Return 1 when the marker matched, or when the alternative handler accepted it (counter incremented in both cases); return 0 otherwise
